lines.text: A social media photo shows a scene of a collapsed building with debris scattered around. Two individuals are standing on a ladder, possibly assessing the damage.

A black car is parked on a cracked asphalt road with a large crack running through it. There are several people standing around the car, including a police officer and a man in a red shirt. The road appears to be in a state of disrepair.

A social media photo shows a group of people gathered around a collapsed building. The debris is scattered across the ground, and there are rescue workers in high-visibility vests and helmets. The scene is illuminated by sunlight, and there are trees in the background.
